title: Cumin Seeds

seo.title: Cumin Seeds (Jeera) - Benefits, Uses and Safety
seo.description: Learn about cumin seeds, or jeera, including their botanical identity, Ayurvedic properties, traditional uses, benefits, dosage and safety considerations.

short_description: Cumin seeds are aromatic seeds traditionally used as a culinary spice and in Ayurvedic preparations to support digestion.
full_description: Cumin seeds, commonly known as jeera, are the dried seeds of Cuminum cyminum. They are widely used as a culinary spice and have a long history of use in traditional Ayurvedic preparations, particularly for supporting digestion and appetite.

recommended_dosage.extract: Use only as directed by a qualified practitioner

ayurvedic_properties.dosha_effect: Traditionally considered balancing for Kapha and Vata when used appropriately; excessive use may aggravate Pitta.

key_benefits.benefit: May help reduce occasional gas and bloating.
Provides aromatic flavour to food and traditional preparations.

therapeutic_uses.use: Traditionally used for indigestion, reduced appetite and occasional abdominal discomfort.
Used in digestive spice blends and decoctions.

safety_and_contraindications.safety: Use moderate amounts; excessive intake may cause heartburn or stomach irritation.
People with reflux, a sensitive stomach, or those taking medicines should consult a qualified healthcare professional before using concentrated preparations.
Stop use and seek medical advice if an allergic reaction or significant discomfort occurs.
